**Summary**  
Patient C3L-00096 has a GNN-A out-of-fold risk estimate of 0.42 for stage III–IV ccRCC. The model attributes ~65 % of the risk signal to tumor-protein features (top drivers: GULP1, TJP3, CORO2B, TNS2, ERBB2, PLCL1, MYO1B, GRB14) and ~35 % to recorded comorbidities (hypertension and hyperlipidemia) [pred:C3L-00096:gnn]. The tumor carries somatic VHL p.L178P and NR4A3 mutations [pt:C3L-00096:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3L-00096:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:8013].

**Evidence paths**  
- VHL protein localizes to mitochondrion and nucleoplasm, linking the canonical ccRCC driver to organelle stress [E3587363][E3598872].  
- NR4A3 mutation associates with insulin resistance (a diabetes precursor) and pyruvate oxidation, connecting the somatic hit to the patient’s metabolic phenotype [E3062544][E3777204][E3598941].
